notes: Candidate palette values are not adopted tokens. All variants include Light and Dark; System follows selected OS mode. First-launch default remains Dark.
Engineering pair checks use unrounded sRGB relative-luminance ratios; reported ratios rounded for display only. Not full WCAG certification.
All editor backgrounds are gray, never white. Font family/size remain app-wide adjustable display preferences, not export formatting.

candidates.name: Preview gray
candidates.description: Closest to the approved preview: middle-gray writing area and dark chrome.

candidates.name: Deep gray
candidates.description: Deepest chrome and darker gray writing area; strongest separation from light mode.

candidates.name: Soft gray
candidates.description: Lighter dark chrome and a pale-gray writing area; gentler surface steps.

candidates.name: Graphite
candidates.description: Crisp dark neutral layers with a medium-gray writing area.

focus.note: Against surrounding surface/surface-raised; editor uses editor-focus.

editor.note: App-wide user-selectable display family/size; default proposal only; export unchanged.

status-bar.note: Quiet durable background outcomes and persistent calendar-update action; blocking warnings/failures remain dialogs.
